title: Operando XAS and DFT Uncover Structure-Performance Relationships in Re/TiO2 for Selective CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol
extraction_notes: No experimental catalyst-performance entries (CO2 conversion, product selectivity, methanol STY/rate, etc.) are reported in the supplied Supporting Information. SI Figure S8 reports operando XANES measurements under CO2 hydrogenation conditions for Re/TiO2 catalysts, but it provides reaction conditions only and no performance values. SI Tables S4-S6 and SI Figures S11-S16 are thermodynamic-equilibrium simulations and were excluded. Characterization and DFT figures/tables were also excluded.
